task.statement:
Implement W385624 / Stage1-B in an isolated native candidate, then independent native review. Source ce6e1b2bf12519a84a3792f06562b7727dfe3021 includes delivered Stage1-A. Read AGENTS.md, v12/DESIGN.md REC-8, v12/python/TESTING.md and own FINDING/PLAN at work/records/2026/11/finding-v12-retained-recovery-admission. Parent contract: work/records/2026/08/finding-v12-isolated-agent-workers/findings/finding-v12-team-hierarchy-shared-approvers/STAGE-1-CONTRACT.md SHA25652c2c640fdbb791e70ae61edf7ef7db7190bacd767d6d044f678517d2e09e1bc; accepted review-2026-11-22T05-18-37Z.md. This task carries M385681 preparation scope, overriding historical not-yet-assigned prose once this Job is selected.
Deliver ACTUAL supported owner read/decision command plus manager-owned linked retained successor admission, not helper-only APIs. Consume Stage1-A owner item/report through existing owners. Present original failed verifier and exact proposed correction/context, failure/report/candidate/base digests and scope before approval. Use delivered principal/scope and deployment decision capability for Slawomir, no future hierarchy/pool prerequisite. Bind owner identity/provenance, operation key, immutable inputs, exact approved profile identity/digest and selected stages. Reject unauthorized decision, generic retry, changed inputs and stale evidence. Denial/hold launches nothing.
New verification/review-only successor identity, never fresh-attempt or implementation redispatch. Persist intent before effects and reconcile partial owner operations; no cross-store transaction fiction. Validate custody/candidate bytes, cancellation, prior cessation/resource exclusion, ownership and limits through owning APIs. Unknown holds; replay exact operands returns one effect, changed operands collide. Concurrent owner decisions must not duplicate admission; crash after reservation/binding or lost reply must not redispatch blindly. Original failure/task/candidate and admitted clocks remain intact.
Product profile stage1-verification-review/1 is the approved definition at parent evidence/stage-1-contract-385615/stage1-verification-review-1.json, SHA2565a6a420e416caab0942f9709939ae01f1f2d9dabbd13e09ff3b03ea08d2932fb: Job9960 incl queue, stages4800, review provider3600, commands900, no automatic retry/correction. This is NOT this development Job heavy7200/9000/21600/900. Persist/check exact profile and stage set. Post-passed-verification expiry preserves evidence and holds owner item; explicit new review-only decision can omit verification with unchanged profile bounds only if exact candidate/verifier/result evidence remains valid. Expiry alone does not invalidate evidence; invalid/unknown refuses, no blind reverify or reset.
Add focused acceptance entry tests.job_manager.test_retained_recovery_admission. Drive the real supported owner command over disposable stores through production authorization and manager admission/readback, not patched command handlers or direct library-only tests. Use deterministic fake execution/host ports at normal boundaries. Prove positive path plus wrong actor/scope/digest/argv/context/profile/stages, duplicate/concurrent decisions, restart/fault cuts, cancel/unknown cessation and review-only valid/invalid evidence. Verify one actual durable successor and no implementation stage/effect. Preserve Stage1-A behavior; record counts, failures/skips and measured durations.
Stage1-C W385625 owns verifier execution and final loop; do not claim it delivered or launch unsupported stages. Expose truthful readiness/refusal at the admission/execution boundary. No broad refactor, general editor/launcher, live recovery/model tests, full suite, main Git mutation or host import. Implementer chooses needed files; shared ownership serial. Existing /3 clarification and independent review apply; escalate only genuine unresolved authority/product decisions. Return exact digest-bound candidate and evidence in own dossier; reviewer checks actual command/admission connectivity and prior guarantees.

work: W385624 Stage1-B only: necessary v12 command/admission/schema/tests and owning dossier evidence; no Stage1-C execution, broader pools or unrelated changes.

acceptance: Stage1-B real owner read/decision command through authorized manager admission/readback, exact retained inputs/profile/stages, replay/cancel/cessation and review-only safety; no implementation redispatch; deterministic connected evidence and independent review.
